<!-- pr-reviewer: 9d52dfb309b64f3aa9b70bffb6365001a7b2ddd0 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (Review label: merge-ready.)

## What looks good

- The stock open run now stands one tool radius plus the stock to leave off its line, on the side that Side names. The centreline ride is gone for stock picks.
- Each new refusal returns a message that names the case and gives the user the next action. Nothing passes silently.
- The part route (`contour_open_run`, #1777) is unchanged. Its messages are byte-identical through the new `PART_WORDS`.
- The climb direction law (#1555) holds on the new route, and a test pins it.
- The decision entry `docs/decisions/1928-stock-open-run-offset.md` records the choice and the dropped options.
- The new module has a provenance line. No new crate dependency. No process files, snapshot PNGs or goldens touched.

## Results (built locally, Windows worktree; head 9d52dfb3, which merges current main 3580f38 with an empty remerge-diff)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build of touched test binaries | pass |
| camcraft-motion lib, `contour_run*` (side + stock) | 16 passed |
| camcraft-app `contour_stock_run` | 5 passed |
| camcraft-app `contour_open_side` | 2 passed |
| camcraft-app `contour_start_point` | 8 passed |
| camcraft-app `contour_arc_fit_wall` | 1 passed |
| camcraft-app `mill2d_b` / `mill2d_c` | 9 / 9 passed |
| camcraft-app `roughing2d` | 7 passed |
| camcraft-geometry `boundary_chains` / `geo2d` | 2 / 15 passed |
| clippy, app + geometry + motion, all targets, -D warnings | clean |

## Mutation check (offset sign)

I flipped the offset side in the review worktree (`tool_left` to `!tool_left` in `contour_run_stock.rs`). Three motion tests and two app tests went RED. They include the distance-and-side pin and the "cuts the part" refusal. The tests reject the direction, not only the distance. I restored the file. The tree is clean, and the suites pass again after the restore.

## Measured distance pins

- The app test measures the minimum and maximum distance of the cutting feeds to the picked line: 5.000 mm within 0.001 mm for each Side (tool D10), and 5.500 mm with stock to leave 0.5.
- The motion test measures 3.000 mm within 0.001 mm (tool D6) for both run directions.
- This carries the measured pin that #1928 asks for, on the stock route. The other routes listed in #1929 (picked face, closed chain, hole rings, control and wear, open boundary, gate proof) still await their pins. That issue stays open. Not a blocker here.

## Notes (not blocking)

- One new refusal has no named test: Side Auto when the part lies on one side at one level and on the other side at another level (`contour_run_stock.rs`, `part_left`). The part route has the twin test `a_run_whose_sides_change_between_levels_is_refused`. Please file a `P7` follow-up to add the stock-route twin.
- The guard for a non-positive offset (`tool radius plus stock to leave`) and the fold refusal shared with #1777 also have no direct named test. The code refuses, so no wrong output can pass.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 3628 lines and grew by 8. The 400-line rule says: flag the growth of a file already over the limit. Not blocking.

## Body checks

- Conventional subject: yes. The body has the `Changelog:` line, and it ends with the closing-keyword line for issue #1928.
- Refused cases named in the body are pinned by tests: the no-part Auto refusal and the "cuts the part" refusal both have app-level and motion-level tests.
- The GUI note change (selection page) follows the "Everything Is a Command" law: it reads the selection, it writes nothing.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
